claims: Pope John Paul II said "We are the Easter people and hallelujah is our song".
Basil Hume said "The great gift of Easter is hope".
The Today Show said "The very first Easter taught us this: that life never ends and love never dies."
Martin Luther said "Our Lord has written the promise of resurrection, not in books alone but in every leaf in springtime."
Robert Flatt said "The resurrection gives my life meaning and direction and the opportunity to start over no matter what my circumstances."
Charles M. Crowe said "Easter is the demonstration of God that life is essentially spiritual and timeless."
Douglas Horton said "On Easter Day, the veil between time and eternity thins to gossamer."
Matthew 28:6 states "He is not here; for he has risen, as he said."
Ravi Zacharias said "Outside of the cross of Jesus Christ, there is no hope in this world."
N.T. Wright said "The cross is not a defeat, but a victory."
1 Corinthians 15:21 states "For since death came through a man, the resurrection of the dead comes also through a man."
Fulton J. Sheen said "Unless there is Good Friday in your life, there can be no Easter Sunday."
